epistemic_policy: Every discovered record remains CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED until human review.
Model-generated synthesis, classifications, embeddings, inferred entities and reasoning chains are not evidence.
Similarity does not imply historical descent, common origin or diffusion.
Publication, version, index, release/update and discovery dates remain distinct.
Archaeological observations remain distinct from inferred symbolic, ritual, social or cognitive meaning.
Ancient-DNA affinity, mtDNA haplogroup, culture, language, technology and social identity are not interchangeable variables.

priority_queue_delta_vs_2026_09_14.note: Five priority records entered and five left relative to 2026-09-14. This is Crossref discovery/indexing/ranking movement only; it is not an evidence-state change. Four of the five entrants are legacy mortuary/ancestor-worship literature newly indexed on 2026-09-14; the fifth is a legacy Neanderthal hunting paper.

new_candidates.title: Radiocarbon dating with cosmic radiation events: problems and unexplored possibilities
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Methodological review of Miyake-event radiocarbon dating, including potential single-year anchoring of stratigraphic sequences and constraints from seasonality, calibration smoothing and regional variation.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: This is a dating-method candidate, not a site-specific chronology revision. Event matching requires sample/context suitability and annual-resolution calibration; it must not automatically overwrite existing archaeological dates.

new_candidates.title: Multiproxy bioarchaeological analyses reveal subsistence shift in Bronze Age Central Europe
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Multiproxy study of Bronze Age Poland (2200–1000 BCE) revises earliest European millet consumption to 1590 ± 50 cal BCE from 1460 ± 40 cal BCE, and reports no strong support for a simple demic-diffusion model.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Dietary isotopes and strontium locality do not establish individual birthplace, ethnicity, language or population descent. Proposed environmental mechanisms are interpretations, not direct causal observations.

dating_change.scope: Earliest evidence for millet consumption reported by this study; human review required before any NOEMA chronology change.

new_candidates.title: Altered Heart-Brain Interaction Related to Ecstatic Phenomena Induced by Insular Electrical Stimulation
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Clinical neurophysiology report on ecstatic phenomena induced by insular electrical stimulation and associated heart-brain interaction.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: An electrically induced modern clinical state cannot establish a universal neural basis of spirituality, religious belief, ancient ritual or historical continuity.

new_candidates.title: Tradition of wrapping grains in funerary rituals 2200 years ago
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Well-dated plant bundles from the Wuwangdun tomb are reported at approximately 2200 cal BP and interpreted as a funerary practice structurally identical to zongzi.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Material similarity and chronological compatibility do not establish direct historical descent, continuity with the Qu Yuan legend, or a unique ritual meaning. Archaeological observations must remain separate from later textual traditions.

provenance.provider: National Science Review / Oxford Academic / PubMed

new_candidates.title: The Effect of Psychedelics on Associative Learning: a Systematic Review
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Systematic review of 62 studies on psychedelics and associative learning; only two included human studies and direct human evidence remains limited.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Predominantly animal and heterogeneous modern evidence cannot be projected onto ancient ritual, religious experience or historical altered-state practices. Mechanistic proposals remain distinct from cultural meaning.

new_candidates.title: A Ritual and Memorial Complex from the Final La Tène Period at the Kartal Site
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Fresh scholarly metadata identifies a 2026 Stratum Plus article specifically focused on a Final La Tène ritual and memorial complex at Kartal.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Only bibliographic metadata was verified in this run. The title's ritual/memorial classification must not be converted into claims about belief, function or social meaning without full source review.

new_candidates.title: Ritual Transformation, Deity Embodiment, and Nagualism in Formative Period Oaxaca – CORRIGENDUM
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Cambridge corrigendum states that Figure 5 and Figure 6 captions in the original article were reversed and have now been corrected.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: This is a source-provenance/figure-attribution correction, not evidence that the article's broader interpretation is confirmed or refuted. Any NOEMA extraction that used the original figure captions would require reconciliation.

source_correction.correction: Figure 5 should be the tableau in the central cache under Structure 35 at San José Mogote; Figure 6 should be the serpentine reclining figure pendant.

provenance.provider: Latin American Antiquity / Cambridge University Press

new_candidates.title: FVLGVR SVBMANIVM inscription and lightning-ritual structure at Hadrian's Villa
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: A marble slab bearing FVLGVR SVBMANIVM was reported in situ near the so-called amphitheatre at Hadrian's Villa; Ministry-linked reporting connects the structure with ritual sacralization of a lightning-struck place and a possible bidental.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: The in-situ inscription and archaeological context support a lightning-ritual interpretation, but identification of the exact structure and full ritual sequence remains interpretive. The finding does not reveal individual private belief.

provenance.provider: ANSA reporting a statement from Italy's Ministry of Culture and excavation team

contradictions_or_method_pressure.summary: Single-year potential is conditional on annual-resolution calibration, seasonality, regional variation and sample/context suitability.
Earlier millet-consumption chronology plus weak support for simple demic diffusion pressures any migration-first narrative.
Clinical electrically induced ecstatic phenomena cannot be projected onto ancient ritual or spirituality.
Structural similarity between plant bundles and zongzi does not by itself demonstrate direct historical continuity with later legend or custom.
Most reviewed studies are animal studies; human direct evidence is limited and neither body transfers automatically to historical ritual.
Title/metadata alone cannot substantiate ritual function or belief claims; full source review is required.
Original article reversed Figure 5 and Figure 6 captions; any downstream visual-source extraction must use the corrected mapping.
Ritualized space and inscription do not disclose individual private belief or the entire ritual script.

dating_revisions.note: Do not change approved NOEMA chronology without human source review and scope reconciliation.

review_items.note: New priority legacy entrants require historiographic/source review; priority movement alone is not evidence.
